title: P15.10-C: governed autonomous Objective driver — scheduler claim → delegated runObjectivePass → settle, with CAS cost admission and fail-closed delegation
description: P15.10-C closes the RECONCILE_ONLY gap left by P15.10-B (BASE 0e27bc6ee236d82633d4aee321ba9cd264adc0c3, the PR #86 merge). Adds src/pair/objective-auto-driver.ts: a bounded production driver that consumes durable wakes through the existing fair-scheduler claim/lease machinery, revalidates the owner's effective auto-policy at every authority boundary (claim, pre-pass admission, and a new optional authority_gate inside runObjectivePass fired before the CEO model call, each review commit, allocation, openWorkItem and delegated-child reconcile write), enforces policy caps (max_ceo_calls, max_missions, budget_microusd_cap incl. in-flight reservation liability, expires_at via evaluate(), retry bound already inside claim()) with CAS pre-spend admission receipts and canonically-derived usage attribution (ceo attempts by started_by, work_open_bindings by created_by, cost_reservation microusd by mission lineage; unbounded/UNKNOWN billing marks cost binding unverified and blocks), honors PAIR_COST_HALT/COST_HALT_FILE, settles every pass through the existing settle()+outcomeContinuation contract, and projects truthful driver readiness into the scheduler status surface (optional injected driver state; default OFF is unchanged). serve-mission-control.mjs wires the driver ONLY under explicit PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1 opt-in (driver_ready stays false otherwise); mission-control-server exposes driver status on the existing owner-scoped auto-scheduler route plus a new read-only auto-driver status route. No new CEO engine, no new planner, no direct executor calls, no merge/deploy — driver defaults OFF everywhere.
